skills.name: Basic Attack: Whack the Dimwit
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Basic Attack combo count.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool
skills.description:
Hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Beat the Blockhead
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
skills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

skills.name: Dodge: Dress Adjustment
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Surprise
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Bangboo Callback
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Code of Conduct
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: Ultimate: The Queen's Attendants
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Duple Meter Allemande
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Evasive Assist: Triple Meter Courante
skills.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing Electric DMG.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup
skills.description: After Rina uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup
skills.description: When  reaches 6 stacks, the next Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Electric DMG. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

skills.name: Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner
skills.description: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 12%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Banquet of Perfection
skills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Increases the duration of Shock inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When Shocked enemies are on the field, all squad members' Electric DMG increases by 10%.

mindscapes.name: Dance Duet
mindscapes.description:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.

mindscapes.name: Master's Paragon
mindscapes.description: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

mindscapes.name: Head Maid's Specialty
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Needle and Hammer
mindscapes.description: Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed. The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.

mindscapes.name: Head Maid Perfectionist
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Stormy Night's Fright
mindscapes.description: When an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the entire squad's Electric DMG is increased by 15% for 8s.
